• Scheduled rides no longer clash (API, driver and passenger, Android and iOS) — a driver with a confirmed 12:30 scheduled ride could still offer on another 12:30 ride and kept getting ride-now requests, and the "Scheduled ride request" dialog was drawn over a live ride-now offer. The existing 60-minute clash window (now in schedule-clash.ts) is enforced everywhere: ride-now dispatch skips drivers holding a scheduled ride within the hour; a fare on a ride-now or an offer on a booking that clashes is refused (SCHEDULE_CLASH); a passenger choosing a driver who is now booked elsewhere is refused (DRIVER_SCHEDULE_CLASH) and that offer withdrawn; when a driver is given a booking their other clashing offers are withdrawn; clashing rides are left off the driver's Requests list and the passenger's offer list; and a passenger cannot book now or schedule within an hour of their own booking still waiting to go out (SCHEDULED_RIDE_CLASH; WhatsApp unchanged). The driver apps hold the scheduled-request dialog back while a ride-now offer is on screen and show it once that offer is answered or expires. New messages in English and Malayalam; iOS docs updated. API typecheck and tests pass (schedule-clash.spec.ts new), driver and passenger unit tests (ScheduleClashTest) and assembleRelease pass.
